verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability to schedule a flag change or release for a specific future time. Several items are related but do not qualify. Driving flags from CI or scripts via the management API (amplitude-docs-5, amplitude-docs-15) is a user-side workaround or developer building block. Prerequisite hierarchies for experiments that 'start at different times' (amplitude-docs-20) are dependency logic, not a time-based scheduler. 'Pre-plan and stage' (amplitude-docs-9) refers to audience staging, not timed activation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time
